_provenance: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE - generated locally with a fixed seed. Figures, URLs and vendor attributions are illustrative placeholders and must not be cited, published or treated as licensed vendor data.
currency_note: All values in EUR unless the source record states otherwise.

conflict_summary.headline: Two licensed syndicated sources report growth rates for what both label 'air treatment' that differ by 5.4 percentage points.

sources.product_title: Consumer Appliances / Air Treatment Products - Western Europe

scope.connectivity: ALL units - connected and non-connected combined
scope.aftermarket_note: Replacement filters and consumables are excluded.

sources.methodology_note: Store audit plus trade interviews, reported at retail selling price in constant prices. Non-connected units still represent the majority of category volume and dilute the growth rate.

scope.geography: Worldwide (APAC and North America are the growth engines)
scope.connectivity: CONNECTED units only - Wi-Fi / app-enabled SKUs
scope.aftermarket_note: Includes filter subscriptions and consumable revenue.

sources.methodology_note: Top-down model anchored on e-commerce panel data, in current prices and USD. Connected-only scope on a low base in fast-growing regions.

reconciliation.verdict: Both figures can be simultaneously correct. They measure different markets, not the same market differently.

divergence_axes.rationale: The connected sub-segment is the fast-growing minority inside a slower total category; isolating it removes the drag.
APAC and North America grow well above Western Europe, which is the most mature air-treatment region.
Current-price series carry inflation that constant-price series strip out.
Consumable and subscription revenue compounds off an installed base that is itself growing.

bridge.note: Bridge is illustrative and additive; contributions are analyst estimates, not vendor-published decomposition.

recommended_planning_basis.scope: Connected Air Treatment, connected units only, Western Europe, constant prices, hardware + aftermarket
recommended_planning_basis.derivation: Euromonitor geography and price basis, Statista connectivity and aftermarket scope.
recommended_planning_basis.caveat: Derived, not vendor-published. Restate against licensed data before any external or investment-committee use.

analyst_actions: Never quote the two headline CAGRs side by side without the scope caveat.
Fix one scope definition in the category charter and hold every downstream model to it.
Request the connected-only Western Europe cut directly from Euromonitor to remove the derived bridge.

supporting_metrics.scope: share of connected units ever paired to the app
